ATX heading style produces hash-prefixed headings

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"heading_style\":\"Atx\"}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<h1>Title</h1><h2>Subtitle</h2>", options: _options)
print(result)
```
